payload.core_composition_summary: DP precomputes which extra stick totals are achievable per suffix; then greedy picks max digit per position using DP table for feasibility.
payload.rationale: Two distinct phases: DP builds reachability table; greedy iterates digits descending, using DP to check if remaining positions can be filled with remaining sticks.
